subject: Provisioning slots matching and term-sheet fallback plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@emberai.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning slots matching and term-sheet fallback plan

Hi Liam / team —

Thanks again for the term-sheet draft. Before we lock sign-off I want to align on a practical handoff for provisioning slots so EmberAI and Redwood have a predictable onramp without blocking the customer. High level ask: can we agree a two-phased slot allocation that pairs OEM manufacturing windows with a cloud-reserve fallback and clear acceptance milestones?

Proposal (high level):
- Phase A (Staging pool, weeks 0–8): EmberAI to hold 20% of committed GPU SKUs in priority manufacturing tranche; Redwood to accept initial staggered delivery for onboarding and integration testing.
- Phase B (Fulfillment + cutover, weeks 8–20): Remaining SKUs shipped by OEM per tranche. If any tranche slips >14 days, cloud-reserve credits kick in to keep customer SLAs.

Key items we need from EmberAI this week:
1) Confirm the OEM slot cadence (dates + min/max per tranche).
2) Shared ETA table (CSV/XLS) we can stitch into our capacity planner.
3) Confirmation whether OEM can assign a soft hold (non-binding) for the first tranche until term-sheet execution.

Attached: EMB-term-sheet-20271001.pdf (term sheet with demo metrics), reference only for the legal items we discussed.

If this matches your expectations I’ll loop finance and legal for DocuSign routing and ask Ben to scope the cloud credit fallback.

Thanks — short bullets and a green check on the three ask items will be perfect.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Marissa.Cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124


-----Original Message-----
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@emberai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+procurement@emberai.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 13:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Provisioning slots matching and term-sheet fallback plan

Marissa — appreciate the clear breakdown. We can support the two-phased approach. Quick status from ops:

- OEM slot cadence: we have tentative windows Oct 18–Nov 01 (tranche 1: ~30% of SKUs), Nov 15–Nov 29 (tranche 2: ~40%), Jan 10–Jan 31 (tranche 3: remaining 30%). These are currently in the OEM queue and subject to PO/term confirmation.
- I’ve attached a machine-readable ETA table with per-SKU lead times and contact SLAs: OEM-ETA-table.xlsx
- Soft-hold: OEM can provisionally hold the tranche if a 50% deposit is cleared; otherwise we can put a 7-day courtesy hold.

Two commercial notes:
1) If you require a hard-hold without deposit, we’ll need to escalate to OEM pricing rework (likely +6–8% on unit price).
2) If cloud-reserve credits are used more than twice across tranches we’ll need to convert those to a mixed billing model to avoid double compensation.

I’ll stand up a quick weekly sync with your procurement lead to keep cadence tight.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Hardware Partnerships | EmberAI
liam.oconnor@emberai.com | +1 617-555-0943

[Attachment: OEM-ETA-table.xlsx (xlsx)]


-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@emberai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning slots matching and term-sheet fallback plan

Thanks Marissa / Liam — this is helpful. A few procurement realities from our side:

- Payment cadence: Redwood can do a two-step payment (30% deposit at PO, 70% on delivery) but our finance team needs the PO no later than Oct 25 to hit that Oct/Nov tranche.
- Cloud fallback: we can provide cloud-reserve credits as a short-term backstop but need an explicit credit reconciliation process (dates used, tokens billed, counter-crediting). If a tranche slips and we spin up cloud capacity we require a 30-day notice window to reallocate node pools.
- Customs / import lead times: if OEM ships from APAC, we should add +10–14 days for customs clearance buffer into tranche planning.

Action items for internal alignment:
- Vanessa: prepare the cloud-credit reconciliation template and estimated $/token burn for fallback (attach: Redwood-proc-checklist.pdf).
- Karthik: map the tranche dates into the Dedicated capacity planner and provide a worst-case fallback cost estimate.

Liam — can you confirm whether the OEM ETA table includes country-of-origin per shipment row? That will help avoid surprises. Also we need the soft-hold mechanics in writing (email is fine).

Ben Carter
Head of Capacity & Procurement | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0202

[Attachment: Redwood-proc-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Provisioning slots matching and term-sheet fallback plan

All — great progress. Summary and next steps so legal/finance can move quickly: 

Summary of agreement:
- Tranche windows: 1) Oct 18–Nov 01 (~30%), 2) Nov 15–Nov 29 (~40%), 3) Jan 10–Jan 31 (~30%).
- Soft-hold mechanics: EmberAI will hold tranche for 7 days post-PO; 50% deposit converts to a 28-day hard hold.
- Fallback: Redwood provides cloud-reserve credits as backstop for tranche slips >14 days; credits to be reconciled monthly and limited to two tranche events before billing model review.
- Customs buffer (+10–14 days) to be baked into Dedicated onramp dates by Karthik.

Deliverables this week:
- Liam / EmberAI: confirm country-of-origin per ETA row in OEM-ETA-table and send written confirmation of soft-hold terms. (Liam — the XLS helps but we need a single-line confirmation for legal.)
- Vanessa: shared reconciliation template and preliminary cost calc (due EOD Thu).
- Karthik: worst-case capacity plan + cost delta if both tranche 1 and 2 require cloud fallback (due Fri).
- Marissa: I’ll route the attached term-sheet to Legal & request a DocuSign envelope for signature once EmberAI confirms the two items above.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/EMB-2027-07-signature
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/EMB-2027-07

If everyone is aligned I’ll mark this as our internal provisioning handoff and route to contracts.
